node: Specialty foodservice distribution and route-density logistics
summary: Layer 1B expansion for restaurant specialty foodservice distribution highlights one reference benchmark and three underfollowed discovery candidates. The core chokepoint hypothesis is that route density, cold-chain reliability, category expertise, specialty sourcing, and embedded service relationships can matter more than headline restaurant brand exposure. Sysco is included only as a reference anchor. Chefs' Warehouse is the cleanest public specialty-distribution mapping. Westrock Coffee adds an adjacent coffee/tea/private-label supply-chain angle with small-cap scale but execution risk. HF Foods is a speculative micro-cap exception because its niche Asian-restaurant distribution model directly matches the route-density/specialty-foodservice node, but its size and financial risk require heavier verification.
